official.description: Applications are invited from suitably qualified candidates for the Pacific Regional Sports Research Scholarship (PRSRS) to undertake a Master's by research degree at The University of the South Pacific (USP). The scholarship is a collaboration between the Oceania National Olympic Committee (ONOC) and USP, with the two partners keen to fund interdisciplinary projects within Economics, Social Impact and Physical Education with a focus on sports. Three scholarships are awarded for the 2026 academic year, tenable from early 2026 and held in any member country of the USP.

applicant_utility.summary: The PRSRS is the ONOC-USP joint scholarship that lets citizens of the 12 USP member countries take a Master's by research at USP on the economics, social impact or physical education of sport, with tuition and compulsory fees paid directly plus a FJD 21,600 living allowance and a return airfare when studying away from home. The 2026 round closed at midnight on 5 January 2026, but USP republishes the same call annually on its postgraduate scholarships page, so a complete pack can be assembled well before the next closing date. With only three awards each year and a strict eight-document email bundle, early supervisor contact and file completeness matter far more than extra credentials.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Early-career teachers, sports administrators and National Olympic Committee staff from USP member countries, around 40 or younger, with a GPA of 3 or above, a sports-focused research idea and the capacity to study full-time without paid employment.
application_readiness_checklist: Assemble all eight required documents before the call closes: Applicant Detail Form, applicant checklist, cover letter, research topic outline, CV, three referees with contact details, certified true copies of transcripts and certificates, and proof of citizenship
Email the bundle to pgrscholarships@usp.ac.fj using the exact subject-line format published on the page (adjust the year to the current call)
Get transcripts and certificates certified as true copies early - certification queues in small island administrations are the usual bottleneck
Confirm three referees are reachable and willing during the selection period, since their contact details are a required part of the pack
Contact a potential USP supervisor to discuss the proposed topic before submitting; the page explicitly invites this
Verify your GPA against the 3.0 threshold on your transcript before committing to the application
common_rejection_risks: An incomplete bundle - one of the eight documents missing or a wrong email subject line - because applications are screened as a single emailed pack
A research outline that does not sit clearly within Economics, Social Impact or Physical Education with a sports focus
A GPA below 3, which the page sets as a firm threshold while the postgraduate diploma is only preferred
Assuming the scholarship secures a university place; applicants must still enrol and be accepted by the academic unit
Planning to keep paid employment during the award, which the conditions prohibit
Expecting dependants or relocation support without meeting the published qualifying criteria for those allowances
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Day-to-day living costs are met by the FJD 21,600 living allowance and tuition, General Services and Health Services fees are paid directly, but applicants still fund study-permit and visa costs where applicable, early research expenses (the research grant is released only after the Academic Unit Research Committee approves the research plan and budget), and any relocation or dependants costs where they do not qualify for the establishment or dependants allowances.
document_audit: Transcripts and certificates must be certified true copies - photocopies merely attested by the applicant do not meet the wording
The Applicant Detail Form is a specific USP PDF linked on the scholarship page; do not substitute a generic cover letter for it
The outline of the proposed research topic is mandatory and serves as the core academic screening document
Three referees with names and contact details are required, not just reference letters
Proof of citizenship must be for one of the 12 listed USP member countries
alerts: The 2026 call is closed - the page carries a midnight 5 January 2026 closing date; monitor the same postgraduate scholarships page for the next annual call rather than assuming the round stays open
Awardees cannot take paid employment during the award and must give up to eight hours a week to teaching for one semester plus an industry placement for another
The scholarship does not guarantee a place in the academic unit, so enrolment and acceptance must be arranged in parallel
Only three scholarships are awarded each year, and the round can close before candidates finish assembling certified documents from overseas offices
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Prepare the eight-document pack, email it to pgrscholarships@usp.ac.fj with the prescribed subject line before the published midnight closing date, while separately securing enrolment acceptance from the intended academic unit.
